4,204 likes, 872 comments - halfbakedharvest on October 21, 2026: "Comment HBH for my Warming Golden Chicken Noodle Soup 🧡

A little curry powder and turmeric and the secret here. I know it sounds different, but trust me on this one. It’s just like the chicken noodle soup we all grew up loving, only even more delicious!

Make it on the stove in a Dutch oven or toss everything into your crockpot and let it cook. SO easy, warming, and delicious. Just what we need on these chilly fall nights!

https://www.halfbakedharvest.com/golden-chicken-noodle-soup/".
